title: Shift Swap Friction by Site
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:shift site_name=* swap_needed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(swap_needed="yes",1,0))) as matched by site_name
| eval a_shift_swap_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_shift_swap_pct
description: Measures the percentage of scheduled shifts that end with a shift swap by site.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which site are helping or hurting scheduled shifts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a shift swap` on `community:shift` events and summarize the hit rate by `site_name`.
visualization: Table of site with percentage of scheduled shifts ending with a shift swap.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often a shift swap happens for each site so you can see where scheduled shifts go smoothly or get stuck.
